description_zh: 调用DescribeNamespaces接口查询命名空间列表

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 0 to 10000

SecretKey.description_en: The secret access key for Application Configuration Management (ACM), used to manage data in an ACM namespace. For more information, see [Differences between an Alibaba Cloud access key and an ACM-specific access key]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/68941.html）
